author: aditsangani
summary: Add paired authenticated HTTPS and WebSocket sessions
details: Add an operator-authenticated session API, separate short-lived phone/Pi bearer credentials, bounded session-isolated WSS relays, explicit revocation/expiry and Pi-token frame upload integration. Require TLS schemes, reject URL credentials/browser origins, preserve original capture metadata and sequence state across reconnects. Add a certificate-verified loopback HTTPS/WSS test. No shared protocol, protected CI, task scope or baseline edits.
validation: 35 backend tests passed locally, including real TLS pairing, invalid/missing credentials, isolated telemetry, generated JPEG upload, expiry, revocation, replay and bounded queues; legacy HTTP replay also passed. Shared repository checks run through checked publishing. No public deployment, hardware, device clocks, inference or capture-age eligibility claimed.
